title: The purpose of this meeting is to consider draft legislation regarding a study on funding for non-public special service schools, modification to charter schools' average daily membership calculations within the education resource block grant model, and charter school eligibility for state educational grants. The meeting will be held in person and remotely, with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov).
